fusions.name: Windrow Cut
fusions.desc: A raking blow that deals 14 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% per affliction on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Tidy Sweep
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 4 damage. It then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Swept Clean
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you.

fusions.name: Leavings Cling
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them.
